events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday shout-out
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second studio album, 'Imagine', was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The powerful album that brought us the timeless title track. Still resonates today, doesn't it?

events.title: Original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond tribute
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 track?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy icon birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your most loved moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track from it is always on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, in 1991.

angles.name: Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. A voice and stage presence truly unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a new direction for the band.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant evolution in their sound. Which track from it stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music continues to resonate around the world. Forever missed, never forgotten.
